content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JNMC AMU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.amu.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JNMC AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the JNMC AMU Recruitment 2026 is 18th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Record Keeper and MTS posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by JNMC AMU for the posts of Record Keeper and MTS (Unskilled). One vacancy is for the Record Keeper and the other for MTS.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: For the Record Keeper post, a Graduation degree is required along with computer knowledge and experience. For the MTS (Unskilled) post, a High School certificate from a recognized board is the minimum qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for JNMC AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the official notification, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Record Keeper post is not exceeding 30 years, and for the MTS (Unskilled) post, it is not exceeding 25 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for JNMC AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JNMC AMU Recruitment 2026 will involve a Skill/Practical Test followed by a Communicative/Interactive Session to assess the candidates' suitability for the roles.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the JNMC AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Record Keeper and MTS (Unskilled) at Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College are contractual in nature, as indicated in the official job notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be downloaded from the official website of Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College (JNMC AMU), which is www.amu.ac.in. Links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, at the Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College (JNMC AMU) campus.
